seasons.name: the Long Wet
seasons.description: Cold rain for months on end, sleet off the harbor, freezing fog in the lanes. Everyone smells of wet wool; the shrines do good business.

seasons.name: the Thaw-Rains
seasons.description: Warm rain that doesn't stop. Gutters overflow, the drowned places spread, and the markets move up a step to keep dry.

seasons.name: the Lantern Months
seasons.description: The mild season of festivals: lanterns strung across every lane, stalls open late, and the rare dry spells that nobody trusts.

seasons.name: the Steam
seasons.description: Muggy heat that makes the rain feel like soup; thunderstorms most evenings, tempers short, ice sellers rich.

seasons.name: the Gales
seasons.description: Wind off the harbor rattling every tarp and sign; storms roll in fast, and the tides run high.

moon.new moon: Old Vesper bleeds through: shadows fall the wrong way, the forgotten walk closer to the surface, and Whisker's ferry runs all night.
moon.full moon: The forgotten are easier to see: faint figures at the edges of lamplight, names half-remembered on the tip of the tongue.
